title: Your first session
summary: Learn the workspace, make a brush, and find the build workflow. Keep the guide beside your editor.

steps.title: Find your way
steps.checkpoint: I can find the camera, grid, asset browser, and inspector.

steps.title: Start and save a map
steps.checkpoint: I have saved an editable .map file.

steps.title: Load materials
steps.checkpoint: I can find and choose a material from my library.

steps.title: Draw your first brush
steps.checkpoint: I can see my brush in both the grid and camera.

steps.title: Move around your map
steps.checkpoint: I can enter Fly and return to Editor mode.

steps.title: Select and transform
steps.checkpoint: I can select, move, duplicate, and undo a change.

steps.title: Work with surfaces
steps.checkpoint: I can select a face and adjust its texture.

steps.title: Add a light
steps.checkpoint: I have placed and configured a light.

steps.title: Build and read output
steps.checkpoint: I can find the build output and identify any reported errors.
